mapper.select: SELECT INTERVIEW_NO, PROCESS_NO, USER_ID, TO_CHAR(INTERVIEW_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS INTERVIEW_DATE, INTERVIEW_LOCATION, INTERVIEW_TYPE, INTERVIEW_PASS_SCORE FROM INTERVIEW WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO INTERVIEW_REVIEW ( INTERVIEW_REVIEW_NO, INTERVIEW_NO, COM_ID, JOB_CODE, INTERVIEW_DATE, INTERVIEW_REVIEW_DATE ) VALUES ( #{interviewReviewNo}, #{interviewNo}, #{comId}, #{jobCode}, #{interviewDate}, SYSDATE )

INSERT INTO INTERVIEW_INFORMATION ( INTERVIEW_INFORMATION_NO, INTERVIEWREVIEW_NO, EVALUATION, INTERVIEW_LEVEL, INTERVIEW_TYPE, INTERVIEW_CONTENT ) VALUES ( #{interviewInformationNo}, #{interviewReviewNo}, #{evaluation}, #{interviewLevel}, #{interviewType}, #{interviewContent} )

INSERT INTO PASS_INFORMATION ( PASS_INFORMATION_NO, INTERVIEW_REVIEW_NO, INTERVIEW_QUESTION, TIP, INTERVIEW_PASS_YN ) VALUES ( #{passInformationNo}, #{interviewReviewNo}, #{interviewQuestion}, #{tip}, #{interviewPassYn} )
